messages:
emily.s: Kickoff: Mosaic Health POC — procurement hit us for MSA redlines + net90 PO. Need legal + security input before e-sign. cc @alex.legal @devon-sec
alex.legal: On it. Can you share the redlines and the order form they attached?
emily.s: Attached in the drive: https://drive.redwood/mosaic/msa_redline_v2.docx. Also PO has 'Net90' and a 10% volume discount clause for pilot.
jordan-sa: Technical note: For POC they need dedicated GPU pool, 2xA100 equivalent for throughput. Also want SLA 99.9 for inference latency <200ms — that's aggressive for batch bursts.
devon-sec: Security Q: They filled our security questionnaire but flagged data residency and HSM/KMS. They want keys in their Azure key vault or HSM in their VNet.
alex.legal: For DPA we can accept EU residency clauses for logs, but HSM in-customer-managed is a Private deployment add-on with additional contract. Need to escalate pricing + SOW.
emily.s: Procurement wants single PO for pilot + option to convert to annual reserved capacity. Finance needs billing milestone mapping. Any formula for converting pilot usage to reserved commit?
jordan-sa: We can map average QPS -> vGPU hours. I can run a quick cost projection if you give expected token counts.
emily.s: They estimated 1M tokens/day during peak week. Can you send the calc by EOD?
jordan-sa: Will do. Also note model variant: they asked for Llama2-70b vs an fp16 distilled variant — latency diff ~30%.
devon-sec: For KMS: support for customer-managed keys in Azure Key Vault is available for Private but requires HSM integration and key-wrapping. Need SOC2 attestation snippet.
alex.legal: I'll prepare a redline summary for MSA + DPA. Quick Q: Are we ok with their SLA amendment to include uptime credit matrix tied to token latency?
emily.s: They want credits if 95th percentile latency >200ms. Our standard is availability-based. Can we offer a capped SLA credit for latency regressions during POC?
jordan-sa: We can offer a best-effort latency SLO for POC with a latency credit up to 5% invoice cap. Need to confirm with eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Deployment requested: allocate POC cluster mosaic-poc-01 in us-east-1. ETA 4 hours.
emily.s: :thumbsup: Thanks. Alex, please send legal redlines + signature flow. Procurement prefers DocuSign with two signers (customer PO + Redwood sales).
alex.legal: Will push redline to drive and flag the KMS/SLA sections. Also need to clarify liability cap and indemnity — customer requested broader data breach indemnity.
devon-sec: We can accept narrower indemnity if they maintain SOC2 Type II and we get incident response SLAs. I'll draft an addendum for incident handling and data access logs.
emily.s: If legal wants a call with their GC, I'm available 3-4pm PST. Procurement may want to loop in finance for net90 terms.
alex.legal: Schedule a 30-min call. I'll include pricing cliff for Reserved conversion. @jordan-sa can you prep the cost projection slides?
jordan-sa: Yep. Sending calc in Slack thread when ready.
emily.s: Thanks team — aim to get signed SO and PO this week. Any blockers?
alex.legal: Blocking: confirmation on KMS path (private vs dedicated) and SLA credit cap. Once agreed, I'll finalize.
devon-sec: Blocking: customer to provide SOC2 report and AAD admin contact for KMS integration test.
jordan-sa: Blocking: confirm model variant and expected peak token distribution. I'll simulate once we have that.
emily.s: I'll ping procurement and request SOC2 and token numbers. Back soon.
